label: Climate model spread
blurb: The day counts depend on which climate model is used. These bars repeat the mean with the lowest and the highest of the three models in each cell.
method: LOCA2-Hybrid provides daily maximum temperature from GFDL-ESM4, MPI-ESM1-2-HR and ACCESS-CM2 (member r1i1p1f1). The lowest and highest readings are taken cell by cell, so they bracket the three models but are not the result of any single model.

charts.title: Mean days above threshold by model reading
